notes.notes: Small changes on The Wreck Devbook

notes.title: Release date postponed
notes.notes:
In the very beginning, we were young and clueless and thought The Wreck would be released around spring 2022. Alas, we were too optimistic, of couse, and finishing the game as well as we wanted took more time, forcing us to push the release to Fall 2022. 
Now, we're ready to go! But in the meantime... one small (and VERY COOL) extra thing has been added to our todo list. What is it? We can't tell just yet. Soon!
The consequence is that we have to move The Wreck's release date - once again. But this time, we can guarantee the game will be out by early 2023. Thanks a lot for your patience, we can't wait for you to play it!
